title: 第十章 一抔黄土，红颜白骨
content_zh:
从枫林城西门出去，沿着官道一直往前走大约七八里地，然后左转走入小径，不出半柱香工夫，就能看到垂柳绕岸的绿柳河。
此时晚风拂面，明月倒映在波光中，一片粼粼。
姜望从小径穿出来的时候，正看到凌河削瘦的背影，杵在河边像一颗沉默的树。
“哎我看看我看看。”赵汝成窜到他面前，吊着脖子道：“一准躲着哭鼻子是不是？”
凌河有些无奈，“你们怎么来了？”
“你声音都有点哑了。肯定哭过！”
这时一个粗犷的声音从河边草丛里钻出来，“姓赵的，你有时候很欠收拾你知道吗？”
“虎哥，你也在啊？”赵汝成缩了缩脖子，杜野虎这蛮汉，那是真的一言不合就动手，并且还不会顾及他的俊脸。
“我本来就在这里喝酒。”杜野虎悻悻说着，满身的酒气在晚风中游荡，“没想到他把那家伙也扛过来了，晦气。”
“就是！还埋他干什么啊？”赵汝成接道：“这种狼心狗肺的东西，就该直接丢到河里，让他顺流而下，喂鱼喂虾。”
姜望往杜野虎出来的方向看了一眼，“他就埋在那里？”
“老三。”顾及到姜望的心情，凌河解释道：“鹏举的坏我没有忘记，但他的好我也还记得。我家境不好，常常吃不饱饭。鹏举总借口让我指点武艺，拉着我不让走，一直拖到开饭的时候。他死了是罪有应得，但我不能看着他曝尸荒野……当然你对我也很好，那年剿青牛寨，你为了救我……”
“说这些做什么？”姜望打断他道：“我爹活着的时候跟我说，成年人跟小孩子不同。成年人第一要学会的，是求同存异。那种我不跟他玩，所以你也不能跟他玩的，是小孩子。你跟方鹏举跟我，咱们各论各的。我不会影响你对他情深义重，你也不会影响我跟他恩断义绝。”
“是这个道理。”凌河说。
他左右看了看夜色下的绿柳河畔，“总有一种恍如昨日的错觉。这里的变化不大，但我们都已经不同了。”
“没有什么是不会变的，这世上唯一的不变，就是永远都在改变。”赵汝成意味深长的说完这句话，又没皮没脸地凑到凌河身前：“埋个人不至于埋到这么晚，你们俩抱头痛哭了是不是？”
话音方落，他便拔地而起，极利落地闪过杜野虎飞来的毛腿。
“啧啧啧，恼羞成怒……”他挑衅的话刚说到一半，又赶紧拱手鞠躬道：“错了错了虎哥。”
杜野虎已经摩拳擦掌的追了上去，“你没错，我正要跟你抱头痛哭一下。”
看着打闹的两人，凌河悠悠道：“但我相信总有一些东西是不会被改变的。”

“你的话，我同意一半。”姜望说。
杜野虎和赵汝成之间的“切磋”，不知怎么后面就变成了四人混战。拳脚并出，各下绊子。打到最后人人气喘吁吁，又一齐放声大笑，又抱头痛哭。
倘若这晚有人路过绿柳河附近，只怕又要传出什么水鬼之类的怪谈了。
兄弟四人最后并肩离开绿柳河，离开这个记录了青春与友谊的地方。
谁也没有再说话。
只是赵汝成最后回头嘟囔了一句：
“到了那边，别再害朋友了。死鬼。”
月光流淌在波光粼粼的绿柳河中，也自还真观残破的屋顶倾泻而下。
不知是不是因为月色的缘故，在这破观里说话的两个人面容都显得极为惨白。
其中一位是个动人的女子，她穿着一身大红的衣裳，身量极妙，凹凸有致。尤其领口微开处那一抹耀眼的白腻，晃得人移不开眼睛。
她的脸容也太苍白了些，按理说会稍显柔弱病态，可她却偏偏给人一种惊人的艳丽之感。大约是因为，她那太过鲜艳的红唇吧？
她就那样毫不介意地坐在那张布满灰尘的香案上，如此美丽却如此坦然。
她用尾指轻轻抹着红唇说道：“这观里的乞儿们都死绝了，真真叫人苦恼，咱们拿什么请神旨？”
声音似乎先到檐角的蛛网转了一圈，才送到它该到的地方，显得有些空落。
“一个修者的命魂就足矣。”
说话的人站在门口的位置，与红裳女不同，他似乎连半只脚都不愿沾进这肮脏的破观，还用一张绣有梅花的手帕捂住口鼻。
“呀呀，说起来轻松呢。”红裳女道，“咱们杀几个凡人都得偷偷摸摸，杀一个修者？怕庄国道院找不上门来么？”
“这城里有一个算一个，早晚都是要死的。”男人说着说着，皱起眉头：“咱们一定要选在这种地方说话么？”
红裳女吃吃笑了：“名传天下的左光烈，就陨落于此。庄国的人里里外外把这里翻了不下十遍，附近再没有哪儿比这更干净啦。”
说到左光烈，她竟微微闭上眼睛，露出一副迷醉的神情，就连那苍白的脸上也迅速泛起了红晕，“我似乎还能嗅到他雄壮的气息呢~”

“说回正事。”男人不动声色地打断她的遐思，“魏去疾可不是好惹的，现在又来了个董阿，咱们必须尽快找到道子。那些秦楚蛮子在这里乱斗，搅得还真观的献祭没法子进行了，要我说，与其陆续偷摸地抓一些凡人来，倒不如直接献祭一个修者，还简单干脆些。”
“找死的法子并不是只有一种，你何必拘泥于此呢？拔剑割喉不好么？或者引雷噬身？”
许是被打断了遐思的不愉，红裳女睁开美目，也收敛了笑意，“在道子现世之前，你最好知道什么叫低调！”
男人似也有些气恼，掩着鼻子道：“妙玉！好像袭击枫林道院不是你的意思似的！现在搅得满城风雨，一个不好，咱们的大事就要功败垂成！”
“你懂什么？这世界太大了，意外太多了！谁能想到左光烈就这样死掉了？还刚好破坏了咱们的献祭计划。忘川河底，白骨已沉寂太久！不能再有意外了！现在的枫林城，董阿至关重要，咱们必须明确他的实力和底线！一定的牺牲在所难免。再者说……”
名为妙玉的红裳女舔了舔嘴唇：“你可知道，这破观里的乞丐并没有死绝？我在枫林城道院里，嗅到了熟悉的味道……”
这脏兮兮的环境令男人愈发不耐：“区区一个乞丐的死活，也值得我关心？”
妙玉这回只漫不经心地伸了一个懒腰，美好身段尽显无疑，“蠢货。”
男人眯起了眼睛，也掩盖住眼底一闪而逝的欲望，“不要以为你名义上是道子的女人，就这样放肆。教门几千年来圣女多了去了，等道子现世，他要不要你，认不认你，还得再看呢。”
“红颜白骨，空兮幻兮。你看不透么？”
“呵呵呵呵。”男人转身往观外走，“我看不看得透，又有什么关系？也就这样了。”
过了许久，这幽静而残破的旧观里，充满诱惑的喃声才轻轻响起，如月色般漾了开去。
“他怎会不爱我？怎会不要我？我守了这么多年，等了这么多年……”
content_en:
Go out from the west gate of Maple Forest City and walk forward along the official road for about seven or eight miles, then turn left and walk into the path. Within half a stick of incense, you can see the Green Willow River with weeping willows on its banks.
At this time, the evening breeze blew on my face, and the bright moon was reflected in the waves, sparkling.
When Jiang Wang came out of the path, he saw Ling He's thin back, leaning against the river like a silent tree.
"Hey, let's take a look, let's take a look." Zhao Rucheng rushed to him, hanging his neck and said, "You must be hiding from crying, right?"
Ling He was a little helpless, "Why are you here?"
"Your voice is a little hoarse. You must have cried!"
At this time, a rough voice came out of the grass by the river, "Zhao, you know how much you need to take care of sometimes?"
"Brother Hu, are you here?" Zhao Rucheng shrank his neck. Du Yehu, a barbarian, would really attack if he disagreed with him, and he would not take his handsome face into consideration.
"I was drinking here." Du Yehu said angrily, the smell of alcohol lingering in the evening breeze, "I didn't expect him to bring that guy over, too bad luck."
"That's right! Why are you burying him?" Zhao Rucheng continued: "This kind of wolf-hearted thing should be thrown directly into the river and let him flow down the river to feed the fish and shrimps."
Jiang Wang glanced in the direction where Du Yehu came out, "Is he buried there?"
"The third child." Considering Jiang Wang's mood, Ling He explained: "I have not forgotten Peng Ju's bad deeds, but I still remember his good deeds. My family is not well off, and I often don't have enough to eat. Peng Ju always made an excuse to ask me to teach me martial arts, and held me back until dinner time. He deserved his death, but I can't watch him leave his body in the wilderness... Of course you were also very kind to me. That year when Qingniuzhai was suppressed, you saved me..."
"What are you talking about?" Jiang Wang interrupted him: "My father told me when he was alive that adults are different from children. The first thing adults must learn is to seek common ground while reserving differences. The kind of child who I don't play with, so you can't play with him, is a child. You and Fang Pengju are with me, and we have our own opinions. I will not affect your deep affection for him, and you will not affect me from breaking up with him."
"That's the truth." Ling He said.
He looked left and right at the Green Willow River in the night, "It always feels like it was yesterday. Not much has changed here, but we are all different."
"Nothing will never change. The only constant in this world is that it will always change." After Zhao Rucheng said this meaningfully, he shamelessly approached Ling He: "It's not necessary to bury someone so late. You two hugged each other and cried, right?"
As soon as he finished speaking, he stood up from the ground and dodged Du Yehu's flying legs with great speed.
"Tsk, tsk, tsk, irritated..." He was halfway through his provocative words, and he quickly bowed and said, "That's wrong, Brother Tiger."
Du Yehu was already gearing up to catch up, "You're right, I was just about to hug you and cry."
Looking at the two people fighting, Ling He said leisurely: "But I believe there are always some things that will not be changed."
"I agree with half of what you said." Jiang Wang said.
The "discussion" between Du Yehu and Zhao Rucheng somehow turned into a melee between four people. The fists and feet come out together, each stumbling. By the end of the fight, everyone was out of breath, laughing loudly, and crying together.
If someone passes by the Green Willow River tonight, I'm afraid there will be strange stories about water ghosts and the like.
The four brothers finally left Luliu River side by side, leaving this place that recorded youth and friendship.
No one said anything more.
But Zhao Rucheng finally turned around and muttered:
"When you get there, don't hurt your friends again. Damn you."
The moonlight flows in the sparkling green willow river and pours down from the broken roof of Huan Zhen Guan.
I don't know if it was because of the moonlight, but the faces of the two people speaking in this ruined view looked extremely pale.
ThatOne of them is an attractive woman. She is wearing a bright red dress. She has an excellent figure and a curvy figure. Especially the dazzling white greasy look on the slightly opened neckline makes people unable to take their eyes away.
Her face is also too pale, and it is reasonable to say that she would be a little weak and sickly, but she just gives people an amazing and gorgeous feeling. Probably because of her too bright red lips?
She just sat on the dusty incense table without any care, so beautiful yet so calm.
She gently wiped her red lips with her little finger and said, "All the beggars in this temple are dead. It's really distressing. What can we ask God for?"
The sound seemed to go around the cobweb in the corner of the eaves first before being sent to where it should be, which seemed a bit empty.
"One cultivator's soul is enough."
The speaker was standing at the door. Unlike the girl in red, he seemed unwilling to touch even half of his feet in this dirty mess, and covered his mouth and nose with a handkerchief embroidered with plum blossoms.
"Yeah, that's easy to say." said the girl in red dress, "We have to be sneaky to kill several mortals, but to kill a cultivator? Are you afraid that Zhuang Guo Taoist Academy won't come to you?"
"Everyone in this city will die sooner or later." The man said, frowning: "Do we have to choose a place like this to talk?"
The girl in red dress chuckled: "Zuo Guanglie, who was famous all over the world, died here. The people of Zhuang State have turned this place over ten times, and there is no place cleaner than this one nearby."
Speaking of Zuo Guanglie, she actually closed her eyes slightly, showing a drunken look, and even her pale face quickly blushed, "I seem to be able to smell his majestic breath~"
"Back to business." The man calmly interrupted her reverie, "Wei Quji is not someone to be trifled with. Now Dong A is here again. We must find Daozi as soon as possible. Those Qin and Chu barbarians are fighting here, which has disrupted Zhen Guan's sacrifice. If you ask me, instead of secretly grabbing some mortals one after another, it would be easier to sacrifice a cultivator directly."
"There is not only one way to seek death. Why should you stick to this? Wouldn't it be better to draw a sword and cut your throat? Or draw a thunder to bite you?"
Perhaps because of the unpleasantness of being interrupted from her reverie, the girl in red clothes opened her beautiful eyes and suppressed her smile, "Before Daozi appears in this world, you'd better know what it means to be low-key!"
The man also seemed a little annoyed, covering his nose and said: "Miaoyu! It seems that the attack on Fenglin Taoist Temple was not your intention! Now the whole city is in trouble, if one mistake is made, our great project will be in vain!"
"What do you know? This world is too big, and there are too many surprises! Who would have thought that Zuo Guanglie would die like this? It just ruined our sacrifice plan. The bones have been lying dormant at the bottom of the Forgotten River for too long! There can be no more surprises! In Maplewood City now, Dong A is very important, and we must clarify his strength and bottom line! Certain sacrifices are inevitable. Besides..."
The girl in red dress named Miaoyu licked her lips: "Did you know that the beggar in this poor temple is not dead? I smelled a familiar smell in Maplewood City Taoist Temple..."
This dirty environment made the man increasingly impatient: "Is the life and death of a mere beggar worthy of my concern?"
This time, Miaoyu only stretched out carelessly, showing off her beautiful figure, "Idiot."
The man narrowed his eyes and covered up the flash of desire in his eyes, "Don't think that you are a Taoist woman in name only, so you are so presumptuous. The sect has had many saints for thousands of years. When Taoist appears, we have to wait and see whether he will want you or not, and whether he will recognize you or not."
"Red face and white bones, empty and illusory. Can't you see through it?"
"Hehehehe." The man turned around and walked out of the viewing room, "I can't see through it, so what does it matter? That's it."
After a long time, in this quiet and dilapidated old view, a seductive murmur sounded softly, spreading like the moonlight.
"How could he not love me? How could you not want me? I have been waiting for so many years..."
